consequence.statement: The DaemonSet uses less memory; no operator action required to receive this improvement.

original.statement: The `istio-cni-node` DaemonSet has improved memory footprint, potentially resulting in up to 80% memory reduction in many cases.

decision.reason: [ev-387dcb005901] describes only an improvement: the istio-cni-node DaemonSet uses less memory, up to 80% less in many cases. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured, loses access or must be migrated. Nothing describes changed functional behaviour either. So the consequence is "none", and the change is informational for an operator who does nothing.
